description: Redemption Headpiece Level 60 Commander Eligor Dawnbringer at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Redemption Headpiece if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Headpiece, 15 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 5 Arcanite Bars and 2 Cured Rugged Hides. Requirements: - Desecrated Headpiece - Wartorn Plate Scrap x 15 - Arcanite Bar x 5 - Cured Rugged Hide x 2
name: Redemption Headpiece
